# VRModule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Core/VRModule.cs#L10)

Base class of every framework module. VRCore finds the modules sitting in the scene, sorts them
by init order and calls [`OnInit()`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/VRModule#oninit) on each; a module reports itself usable by calling
[`SetReady()`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/VRModule#setready) and publishes what it offers through [`RuntimeRegistry`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/RuntimeRegistry).

```csharp
public abstract class VRModule : MonoBehaviour
```

## Methods

### OnCleanup() {#oncleanup}

Where the module gives back what it claimed - unregister services, drop subscriptions. Called by
VRCore when the scene is torn down.

```csharp
public virtual void OnCleanup()
```

[View source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Core/VRModule.cs#L46)

### OnInit() {#oninit}

Where the module starts itself up: register services, read settings, and finish by calling
[`SetReady()`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/VRModule#setready). Called by VRCore, in init order.

```csharp
public abstract void OnInit()
```

[View source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Core/VRModule.cs#L40)

### SetReady() {#setready}

Marks the module usable and raises [`OnModuleReady`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/VRModule#onmoduleready). Call once, at the end of
startup. Calling it a second time is ignored and logs a warning.

```csharp
protected void SetReady()
```
